request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN

layers.text: A small colour change only: his skin (face, ears, chest, belly, arms, legs) becomes one shade darker and greener, a medium leaf green with a slightly darker green shadow tone; and the red-orange leather hood, straps and loincloth become a browner orange-brown saddle leather, not red. Keep everything else exactly the same: the goggles, the bomb with its yellow stripes and spark, gloves, boots, satchel, pose, proportions, thick black outline and art style, on a transparent background.
